resources.string: Notifications shown after quiet hours end
In system settings, enable this app from the list.
Notification Scheduler blocks or delays notifications from apps you choose during quiet hours so you can stay focused.
You won't see every app at once. Use + to add only the apps you want to manage.
Choose start and end times per app. Block notifications entirely, or show them again with the same content when quiet hours end.
Optionally block selected apps' notifications on Saturday and Sunday. Weekday rules stay the same.
Notification access is required to manage alerts. When Settings opens, enable Notification Scheduler.
Set a night window for any app; notifications pause during that time.
Delayed alerts wait in the hourglass; content is not lost.
When quiet hours end, the notification returns with the same text.
Choose the apps whose notifications you want to manage.
Tap an app to add it to your list.
Quiet hours active for this app
Notifications are removed during quiet hours.
Notifications are saved and shown again when the window ends.
Default quiet hours applied to newly added apps.
Grant usage access to see how long selected apps were used today.
On Saturday and Sunday, notifications from selected apps are blocked.

Last updated: 20 September 2026
1. Introduction Notification Scheduler (“App”) blocks or delays device notifications according to quiet hours you set. This Privacy Policy explains how data is handled.
2. Data controller Independent developer Doğuş İpeksaç. Contact: ipeksac.dogus.19@gmail.com
3. Data processed Processed locally on your device: quiet-hour rules, preferences (theme, weekend off, language), temporarily delayed notification content, and permission states. No account, cloud sync, ads, or tracking SDKs.
4. Purposes Enforce your rules, reschedule delayed notifications, remember preferences, and keep the App reliable.
5. Sharing Data is not sent to external servers or sold. Disclosure may occur only if legally required.
6. Retention Rules/preferences until you delete them or uninstall. Delayed notification records until shown or no longer needed.
7. Permissions May request notification access, posting notifications, exact alarms, battery optimization exemption, installed-app list, and usage access.
8. Your choices Revoke permissions, clear app data, or uninstall anytime.
9. Changes This policy may be updated in the App.
10. Contact ipeksac.dogus.19@gmail.com
